Who We Are

More than tutoring —
we're a community.

Pathways Learning Hub is a nonprofit organization dedicated to providing high-quality tutoring services for youth in the Kent, Washington area. Our mission is to support academic success by offering personalized guidance, engaging daily activities, and a safe, encouraging environment for students to thrive.

Through sports, games, team-building, and social enrichment, we help kids build strong bonds while learning and growing together. We are here to help every child reach their full potential — and every family feel at home.

From afterschool homework help to college application workshops, monthly book clubs, basketball tournaments, summer camp, and one-of-a-kind community events like Tennis & Matcha — Pathways is built for the whole community.

✦ Fun Facts
We offer sports & team games every week, building friendships that last a lifetime.
Students enjoy hands-on STEM, art, and reading time every day after school.
Pathways is Somali-founded and proudly women-led — blazing a trail for the next generation.
We host Camp Pathways every July & August for youth summer enrichment.
Every June we host Seattle Somali Soccer Week — a beloved community celebration.
Our signature Tennis & Matcha event brings the community together in a whole new way.

Our Story

Who We Are

Founded in Kent, rooted in community.

Pathways Learning Hub was established in 2024 by Somali women in Kent, Washington who saw a need — and decided to meet it. What started as afterschool tutoring has grown into a full ecosystem of programs serving youth and families across the community.

We believe every child deserves a safe space to grow, a mentor who believes in them, and a community that has their back. From daily tutoring to college readiness workshops, basketball tournaments to book clubs, summer camp to our signature Tennis & Matcha event — Pathways is built for the whole family.

We are proudly Somali-founded, women-led, and committed to making every program 100% free and accessible to all.

Our Mission
"To support academic success and social growth by offering personalized guidance, enriching activities, and a safe, encouraging environment where every child can reach their full potential."

Our Programs

Every pathway starts here.

Six distinct programs designed around what Kent youth actually need — from daily tutoring to college apps, book clubs to summer camp.

Sports Programs

Built to compete. Built to belong.

Girls basketball, boys basketball, and soccer — weekly open gyms, skill-building, and quarterly tournaments that bring the whole community out to cheer.

Annual Event

Seattle Somali Soccer Week

Every summer, Pathways Learning Hub hosts Seattle Somali Soccer Week — a week-long celebration of sport, culture, and community pride. Teams compete, families gather, and the bleachers fill with energy.

From the opening kickoff to the final whistle, Soccer Week is more than a tournament — it's a homecoming for the entire Somali community across the Pacific Northwest.

⚽ Multi-Team Tournament 📍 Kent, WA 🗓️ Every Summer 👨‍👩‍👧 All Ages Welcome

Support Our Mission

Help us keep it free.

Every program at Pathways Learning Hub is completely free for families — because we believe cost should never be a barrier to opportunity. But that's only possible because of generous donors like you.

Your contribution directly funds tutoring supplies, sports equipment, book club materials, summer camp experiences, college readiness workshops, and the staff who make it all happen.
